title: Migrate dependency management to a root and demo pnpm workspace
body:
Supersedes #5085 and #5128.

Migrate the root and demo to pnpm with a shared lockfile, frozen CI installs, supply-chain checks, and pnpm packing and staged publishing. Keep entry-point manifests out of the workspace and retain the independent benchmark workspace.
commits: Migrate dependency management to a root and demo pnpm workspace
Remove historical npm fallback from build workflow
Use pnpm for release packing and staged publishing
Avoid dependency cache for main builds
